lessons.title: Adding Two-Digit Numbers
lessons.content: Learn how to combine two numbers. For example, 12 + 15 = 27. Start by adding the ones column, then the tens column.
lessons.santaliContent: ᱵᱟᱨᱭᱟ ᱮᱞᱠᱷᱟ ᱢᱮᱥᱟ (Addition) ᱪᱮᱫᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱫᱟᱹᱭᱠᱟᱹ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱛᱮ: ᱑᱒ + ᱑᱕ = ᱒᱗᱾ ᱯᱩᱭᱞᱩ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ (ones) ᱟᱨ ᱛᱟᱭᱚᱢ ᱛᱮ ᱜᱮᱞ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ (tens) ᱢᱮᱥᱟᱭ ᱢᱮ᱾
